2014_spells.heroism.description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this spell.
2014_spells.heroism.effectSummary: Make a target frightened until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.heroism.fullDescription: Using 1 action, a willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns; When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this spell. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
